title: Nonnegativity of the $L^2$ norm squared
statement:
Let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be a Boolean function of arity $n$. Then its $L^2$ inner product with itself is nonnegative:
\[
  \langle f, f\rangle \;=\; 2^{-n}\sum_{x\in\{0,1\}^n} f(x)^2 \;\ge\; 0.
\]
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function of arity n (f : {0,1}^n → ℝ)
